ns0:g.ns0:text: 3 UE | 120 kHz | 1200 B UDP UL | six business seeds | post-hoc matched business IDs

ns0:text.style: fill: #444444; font: 9px 'Liberation Sans'; font-family: Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

ns0:g.ns0:text: Negative = shorter delay. Left: the same 4000 IDs per flow; stage differences add to the total mean change.

ns0:text.style: fill: #444444; font: 9px 'Liberation Sans'; font-family: Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

ns0:g.ns0:text: Right: one policy selects the 40 slow IDs, then both policies are evaluated on those IDs. Selection is outcome-dependent.

ns0:text.style: fill: #444444; font: 9px 'Liberation Sans'; font-family: Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

ns0:g.ns0:text: Arithmetic means across six seeds; not primary P99, confidence intervals, or causal shares. Original trial history retained.
